meta.title: Improve F# compiler loop handling
meta.body_summary: Optimize F# compiler to skip generation of try..with wrappers around loops that don't use break/continue, reducing generated code overhead.

perf_labels.notes: Single-commit compiler optimization merged instantly with no review; no benchmark evidence, but change is low-risk and reduces code generation overhead.

core_change_summary.description: In compiler/x/fs/compiler.go, the F# compiler backend now checks whether break/continue are used before emitting try..with wrappers around loops; loops without break/continue skip the wrapper. Many test output files are updated to reflect cleaner generated code without the wrapper.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Most changed test files had 3-line deletions (the try..with block); a few required larger adjustments due to different loop structures.
change_trajectory: Single commit: `fs compiler: omit break/continue handling when unused` updated compiler logic and regenerated all affected test snapshots.
